sources.title: Purple Mountain (Nanjing)
sources.excerpt: Purple Mountain or Zijin Shan is located on the eastern side of Nanjing in Jiangsu province, China. It is 448.9 metres (1,473 ft) high, with it being the highest in Nanjing when compared to other mountains in the city. Its peaks are often found enveloped in purple and golden clouds at dawn and dusk, hence its name.
